items.title: Survey shows Nova Launcher still crushes every Android launcher that challenges it
items.summary: Despite years of turbulence, Nova is still the star of many home screens.
items.body: Picking and sticking with an Android launcher is a hugely personal decision. I would know — I regularly switch between launchers for my job but often default to my preferred home screen, AIO Launcher . This suggests that change for the sake of change isn’t the norm when picking a home screen, and it’s perhaps a core reason why the majority of readers in a recent poll admitted to sticking with Nova Launcher. My colleague Marvin Velasco recently tested seven of Android’s biggest launchers , ranking each and asking readers to vote for their primary option. While Marvin put Nova Launcher last on the list, the poll results couldn’t disagree more.

items.title: Android Auto’s endless calling loop is driving Pixel and Galaxy owners crazy
items.summary: Gemini knows the name to contact. Android Auto keeps asking.
items.body: TL;DR Some Pixel and Samsung Galaxy owners say Android Auto repeatedly asks who they want to call or message, even after they provide a contact’s name. Google’s Android Auto community specialists are collecting diagnostic details to investigate, but there’s no confirmed cause or fix yet. The complaints come as Gemini rolls out more widely in Android Auto. Making a hands-free call shouldn’t feel like an interrogation. You say a contact’s name, Android Auto places the call, and your hands stay on the wheel. But for some Pixel and Samsung Galaxy owners, that simple exchange has turned into an endless conversation with a particularly forgetful assistant. No matter how many times they repeat the name, Android Auto keeps asking the same question: Who do you want to call? The complaints have been piling up on Google’s support forums since early October, with reports involving the Pixel 10, Pixel 10 Pro, Galaxy S24, Galaxy S25 Ultra, and Galaxy S26. Both calling and texting are affected, leaving some drivers unable to reach their contacts through voice commands.

items.title: New Android exploit only needs you to install an app to wreck your phone
items.summary: Android sabotages itself next.
items.body: TL;DR Bitdefender researchers discovered an Android vulnerability that can trigger an endless crash loop simply by installing a specially crafted APK, potentially leaving devices unusable. The flaw exploits how Android handles ZIP compression methods, repeatedly crashing the core system_server process. Recovering may require a factory reset or manually deleting the malicious file using ADB. No in-the-wild exploitation has been identified, but the public disclosure could make it easier for threat actors to develop an exploit. Even though Android is a relatively safe operating system, with several security measures in place , threat actors’ ingenuity still keeps finding ways to exploit weaknesses. We recently shared information about malware that can empty your bank accounts in secret , and now, researchers have found a separate Android flaw that could leave your phone outright unusable. Normally, malicious apps need to request permissions and execute code to attack your device. However, researchers at Bitdefender have discovered a new vulnerability dubbed GhostMap that triggers a crash loop simply by installing a specially crafted app.

items.title: You can now play Switch 2 games on Android via emulators and native ports
items.summary: It's early days, but Switch 2 emulation and native ports show a lot of promise.
items.body: Credit: Oliver Cragg / Android Authority TL;DR We’ve seen the first Nintendo Switch 2 emulators on Android, although many games aren’t playable. We’ve also seen the BananaNative project, which enabled native ports of Donkey Kong Bananza and Mario Kart World on Android. It’s still early days for these projects, but it’s clear that Switch 2 emulation and native ports are progressing incredibly quickly. The Nintendo Switch 2 launched just over a year ago, but we weren’t expecting to see emulators or native ports on Android for a while yet. However, that’s exactly what’s happened in recent weeks. We’ve seen Nintendo Switch 2 emulators landing on various platforms in the last week or two, and they all seem to be ultimately based on the acclaimed Eden emulator for Nintendo Switch 1 titles. Android isn’t left out of the fun, as we’ve also seen Eden SX2A , which is based on the PokeDinner emulator for other platforms. In fact, PokeDinner is in turn based on the so-called Eglantine emulator. And that particular emulator is based on Eden-NS2, which is itself a fork of the original Eden emulator for Nintendo Switch 1 titles. Forking heck.

items.title: One UI 9 is breaking Wi-Fi, mobile data, and even SIM detection for some Galaxy users
items.summary: Stable One UI 9 may not be that stable after all.
items.body: TL;DR Several Samsung users have reported issues with mobile data, Wi-Fi, and SIM detection after updating to One UI 9. Restarting the phone or toggling airplane mode seems to temporarily resolve the problem. A permanent fix hasn’t been discovered for any of the connectivity problems. Samsung has been rolling out the stable One UI 9 update to Galaxy phones over the last few months. Although it introduces several new features and brings some Galaxy AI features to older Samsung flagships, the update process doesn’t seem to be going smoothly for everyone. According to threads on Reddit and the Samsung Community forums , several users have been experiencing connectivity problems since installing the One UI 9 update. items.body: إيقاف ومنع ثم إقالة؟.. مستقبل حسام حسن يشتعل داخل منتخب مصر كشفت تقارير إعلامية أن اتحاد الكرة المصري بات قريبًا من إقالة حسام حسن، مدرب منتخب مصر، بعد الجدل الذي أحيط حول حياته الشخصية في الفترة الماضية. وكان المجلس الأعلى لتنظيم الإعلام في مصر قرر أمس الأربعاء منع ظهور حسام حسن على جميع الوسائل الإعلامية ، وهو القرار الذي تزامن مع إيقاف المدرب من جانب الاتحاد الدولي لكرة القدم "فيفا" 3 مباريات. ويستعد منتخب مصر لخوض معسكر نوفمبر الجاري، على أن يواجه مالاوي في مباراتي الجولتين الثالثة والرابعة من التصفيات المؤهلة لكأس أمم أفريقيا 2027، يومي 13 و17 من الشهر الجاري. ورغم تجديد عقده حتى 2030 في وقت سابق، يبدو اتحاد الكرة في طريقه للإطاحة بحسام حسن، فيما يبرز اسمان محليان لتولي المهمة بعده استعدادًا لنهائيات كأس أمم أفريقيا 2027. وحسب مصادر قناة مودرن MTI المصرية، فإن اتحاد الكرة "قرر إعادة تقييم موقف حسام حسن من الاستمرار في قيادة المنتخب المصري، بعد الجدل المثار حول حياته الشخصية، وهناك اتجاه لإقالته". وأشار المصدر نفسه إلى أن القرار لم يُتخذ بشكل نهائي، إلا أن المسؤولين بدأوا بالفعل التحضير لسيناريو مرحلة ما بعد العميد. وأوضح أن الأقرب أن يكون مدرب المنتخب المصري القادم وطنيًا، فيما يعتبر حسام البدري، وعلي ماهر الأوفر حظًا، علمًا بأن الأول سبق له تولي المهمة في وقت سابق.

Long-pressing a conversation will soon pop up recent messages and a refreshed context menu, while leaving the sender’s message unread. Unlike iOS, Android’s peekable preview card will let you scroll up to inspect more messages discreetly. WhatsApp offers users a global toggle for read receipts, letting them control whether they send and receive blue ticks for when messages are read. items.body: هل نجا من الطرد؟   قال تقرير صحفي، إن هاري ماجواير، نجم مانشستر يونايتد، متهم بالإمساك بسانتياجو كاسترو، لاعب روما، من منطقة حساسة خلال مواجهة الفريقين في دوري أبطال أوروبا. وعاد مانشستر يونايتد من تأخره بهدفين نظيفين للفوز بثلاثة أهداف في الشوط الثاني، في ملعب أولد ترافورد بعد بداية كارثية. وقد اشتدت حدة مباراة دوري أبطال أوروبا لدرجة أن ماجواير ، 33 عاماً، وكاسترو، 22 عاماً، تشاجرا بطريقة غريبة للغاية. ووفقا لصحيفة " ذا صن "، قام مدافع مانشستر يونايتد بسحب الكرة من المهاجم بتدخل عنيف حيث بدا أنه اندفع برأسه أولاً نحو الكرة وساقي خصمه. أثار ذلك غضب كاسترو، فركض نحو اللاعب الدولي الإنجليزي وبدا وكأنه يمسكه من رقبته بكلتا يديه. ورد ماجواير على الفور، وبدا أنه أمسك بشكل مثير باللاعب الأرجنتيني الدولي من الأسفل قبل أن يسحبه إلى الأرض. ناقش الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات كووورة تم نشر لقطات من ذلك الاشتباك الغريب لكنها لم تكن حاسمة، حيث أبدى مشجعو روما غضبهم الشديد على وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي وانتقدوا الحكم بشدة لعدم طرده ماجواير، مؤكدين أنه أمسك "بأعضاء خصمه التناسلية" قبل أن يسحبه للأرض. لكن مدرب فريق الدوري الإيطالي جيان بييرو جاسبيريني لم يتطرق إلى الحادثة بعد انتهاء المباراة.

Cloud connect lets the Xbox Nano Controller connect directly to cloud servers over Wi-Fi, which Microsoft says can help reduce input lag. Xbox Cloud Gaming is a convenient way to play Xbox games on your smart TV without a console. But what if you don’t have a controller handy? Microsoft is now trying to fix that by letting you turn your phone into an Xbox controller. The company has announced two new Xbox Cloud Gaming previews. items.body: TL;DR A security firm has found that hackers exploited a Chrome bug and a Qualcomm Adreno GPU driver flaw to infect Android phones that visited a booby-trapped website. The attack targeted Chrome versions 139 to 145 on Android and stole browser cookies, saved logins, browsing history, and Wi-Fi passwords. Both flaws had already been patched, so phones running up-to-date Chrome and security updates remained safe. Security researchers at Sekoia have detailed a mobile hacking campaign that went after Android and iPhone users through hijacked and fake websites. On Android, the attackers didn’t need victims to tap a link, install an app, or grant a permission. Opening an infected page in an outdated version of Chrome was enough. According to Sekoia’s report , the attack on Android worked in stages. First, it used a Chrome flaw tracked as CVE-2026-3910 to run code inside the browser. It then exploited CVE-2025-27038, a bug in Qualcomm’s Adreno GPU driver, to break out of Chrome’s sandbox and gain deeper access to the phone. Since Adreno graphics are found in Snapdragon chips, phones powered by Qualcomm’s silicon were the ones affected.

The Bluetooth Special Interest Group (SIG), the standards organization that oversees Bluetooth technology, today shared a significant update that could standardize lossless and high-resolution Bluetooth audio . It announced the adoption of Bluetooth High Data Throughput (HDT), which essentially increases Bluetooth LE’s maximum supported bit rate to 7.5Mbps. That’s nearly four times the current maximum. Wide foldables are incredibly popular — far more than we expected. That popularity may also be driven by growing demand for smaller, but not less powerful, phones, as well as the proven convenience wider screens offer over tall phones in terms of usability. items.title: 9 things to do on day one to keep any foldable alive longer

items.body: Credit: Paul Jones / Android Authority Apple’s first foldable has had a rough start. Shortly after launch, iPhone Duo owners began reporting cracked inner screens , and Apple has since said the number of affected units will remain limited, pointing those affected to AppleCare for a screen replacement. It’s a reminder that, seven years after the first Galaxy Fold, foldables still ask a little more of their owners than slab phones do. The good news is that most of what keeps a foldable alive is habit, not luck. I’ve used a Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 6 for two years, and its hinge and inner screen are still in great shape. items.title: This treadmill owner used Claude to escape a subscription trap, and it’s glorious
items.summary: The results are making other treadmill owners take notice.
items.body: TL;DR A NordicTrack owner used Claude Code to escape iFIT’s subscription restrictions on their treadmill’s screen. The AI-assisted makeover added Netflix, Crunchyroll, and a custom workout interface without sacrificing essential controls. The owner has made the project public on GitHub for others who want to try something similar. A treadmill is supposed to make you sweat , not negotiate with a paywall. But NordicTrack apparently had other ideas, selling a machine with a big, beautiful screen that demands an iFIT subscription before it can become the entertainment hub you’ve paid for. One owner’s response? Call in Claude , evict the subscription headaches, and give the machine a second life. As detailed in a Reddit post, the owner’s girlfriend bought a NordicTrack Commercial 2250 a couple of years ago, with its large display as one of the biggest attractions. items.title: I tested the iPhone 18 Pro’s and Pixel 11 Pro’s photo styles, and there’s a clear winner
items.summary: The iPhone 18 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro take different approaches to photo filters. Here's why I prefer Apple's.
items.body: Credit: Stephen Radochia / Android Authority There’s no arguing that smartphone cameras have gotten really good. In fact, I believe that there are no bad cameras as far as flagships go, just different flavors. Sure, bigger sensors and better lenses help, but the key differentiator today is the processing, color science, and the level of control you get over images. To that effect, I spent the past month shooting with the iPhone 18 Pro and Google Pixel 11 Pro to see how their newfangled approaches to creative control compare. On the iPhone 18 Pro, Apple has reworked its Photographic Styles, giving you more control over the look and texture of your photos. Google, meanwhile, has introduced Camera Looks, a collection of presets that let you change the Pixel’s signature image processing.

items.title: Google is giving Chrome’s three-dot menu a much-needed brain
items.summary: No more digging through Chrome's endless menu options.
items.body: TL;DR Chrome’s redesigned three-dot menu now features a functional search box for finding browser actions, bookmarks, and recent history. Google is also experimenting with a scrollbar, pinned search field and footer, and cleaner, block-style menu sections. The redesign remains exclusive to Canary, with no confirmed stable release date. Chrome ‘s three-dot menu has always been a bit of a treasure hunt. You know the setting you’re looking for is buried somewhere in there, but finding it can mean scrolling through a maze of options or remembering which submenu Google decided to hide it under. Now, Google is working on a shortcut that could make all that digging unnecessary. And the latest Chrome Canary build shows it’s finally coming together. The latest development comes courtesy of Leopeva64 on X , who shared a demonstration of the now-functional search box in Chrome’s redesigned three-dot menu. Previously little more than a decorative placeholder, the search field can now pull up matching browser commands, bookmarks, and recently visited websites as you type.

items.title: This app brings free internet radio to Android Auto, and it’s only getting better by the day
items.summary: RadioShake is completely free and doesn't even show ads.
items.body: TL;DR RadioShake is an internet radio app for Android Auto that supports over 45,000 radio stations. Its latest update introduces autoplay for your last played station and also improves song recognition. The app is completely free, has no ads, and doesn’t require an account. Listening to music is one of the many pleasures of going on a road trip. It can even make commuting to work easier. While there are a lot of music streaming apps where you can curate your own playlists, sometimes it’s just more fun to listen to the radio — especially if you have an internet radio app that lets you tune in to stations from around the world. That’s exactly what RadioShake was built for, and it’s only getting better with each update. There’s a special kind of frustration that comes from a button doing exactly what it says, just not what your fingers remember. It seems to be a server-side rollout, so you may have to wait for the feature to show up. I’ve always found Memories in Google Photos to be a useful and fun feature that often takes me back to the “good old days.” Whether it’s surfacing old clips of my friends and me from college or images from my first date with my wife, it’s usually great at showing the best moments of my life over the years. However, it sometimes adds the weirdest background music to Memories , which can pull you out of the experience. Fortunately, you can now stop that. Google today announced that it’s finally giving users the option to turn off background music in Memories. This means you won’t get random music tracks added to your Memories in Google Photos. For Memories that contain video, users will still hear the recorded audio.

items.title: Chrome could soon make tab overload a lot easier to manage

items.title: These muscle-reading wearables let you use voice input without speaking a word

items.body: TL;DR Subvocal’s glasses tech uses radar to analyze the movement of muscles in your mouth. From those readings, it can extrapolate the words you’re saying — even if you’re just silently mouthing them. Pre-orders for the wearable are open now, with orders expected to ship in Q1 2027. Ever since mobile devices started getting smaller than a laptop, engineers have been tackling the difficult question of how we’re supposed to enter text. We’ve gone from tiny physical keyboards , to touchscreen keyboards, to gesture-based glide typing . On wearables, the situation’s even trickier, and it can feel like we’re stuck either using voice input or left awkwardly poking in the air at a virtual keyboard. But now one startup has a clever, hands-free solution that works silently. How many of you speak aloud to yourself as you type? Or maybe when proofreading, do you ever silently mouth the words as you’re reading them? You might be a prime candidate for trying out Subvocal’s glasses tech, which translates silent mouth movements into written text (via Hacker News ).

When Google started its search business in 1998, it stated that its mission was “to organize the world’s information and make it universally accessible and useful.” Even though it still uses those words when it talks about Search, anyone who’s used AI Mode knows that it has strayed far from that original intent. Now there are signs that it might be ready to return to its roots.
